title: reducedConstantLowerShriekAssertions_of_reduction_data
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], f:X → Spec k a separated finite-type curve of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], X reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme], j:U → X an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and r a prime. Put R=ULift(Z/rZ) and let R_U/(r) denote the constant R-module sheaf with value R/(r) [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Assume ReducedConstantLowerShriekReductionData(f,j,r) [k1-reduced-constant-lower-shriek-reduction-data]: a finite surjective smooth modification is isomorphic over a dense open, and its pulled-back lower-shriek coefficient sheaf satisfies the eight assertions. Then j_! R_U/(r) satisfies the eight assertions for f.

proof.text: Unpack the finite, surjective, smooth, dense-open-isomorphism and pullback hypotheses from the reduction data, then apply AlgebraicGeometry.IsCurve.Assertions.lowerShriek_constantModSheaf_of_finite.

proof_origin: Application of the existing finite transfer theorem recorded by lemma-weil-pbc-curve-normalization-constant (Stacks 0A3Q).

        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) j).obj
